_comment: Lenses are the algorithms a chant can open. A lens chant is 4 words = 40 bits:
2 version | 6 lens id | 20 params | 6 checksum. The frame you hold supplies the dimension;
params index that dimension's field table in MISSIONS.json. Same codebook as every chant.

1.name: select
1.tile: exact values of the selected fields at the frame's tick

2.name: delta
2.tile: exact change of each selected field between the two ticks

3.name: alarm
3.tile: TRUE/FALSE answer plus the exact value
